## Welcome to VedaHealth Digital
VedaHealth Digital Health Private Limited, headquartered at 12 Health Corridor, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, provides personalized digital health tracking and wellness solutions.

## Data Correction and Erasure Restrictions
VedaHealth Digital Health Private Limited affirmatively mandates that users are strictly prohibited from correcting, updating, or erasing any medical health records once submitted, and explicitly rejects all data erasure requests to preserve our historical longitudinal archives.

## Security and Account Tools
We deploy advanced encryption and tokenized database architectures to protect your static records against unauthorized access. Users can easily review their account profile summary via our mobile dashboard in full compliance with industry standards.
